parameters.name: AcrRegistryInfo
parameters.description: The Container Registry instance information. For more information, see [Pull images from Container Registry without using a password](~~194250~~).

sub_parameters.name: ArnService
sub_parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the RAM role in the account that has resource ownership of the ECI instance and other resources.

sub_parameters.name: ArnUser
sub_parameters.description: The ARN of the RAM role in the account to which the Container Registry instance belongs.

sub_parameters.name: Domain
sub_parameters.description: The domain name of the Container Registry Enterprise instance. The default value is all domain names of the corresponding instance. You can specify individual domain names, separated by commas (,).

sub_parameters.name: InstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The instance ID of the Container Registry Enterprise instance.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the Container Registry Enterprise instance.

sub_parameters.name: RegionId
sub_parameters.description: The region where the Container Registry Enterprise instance resides.

parameters.name: Annotations
parameters.description: The annotations. This parameter is not available for public use.

parameters.name: AutoMatchImageCache
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable image cache reuse. If this feature is enabled, a newly created image cache can reuse image layers from existing image caches, which accelerates image cache creation. Valid values:

- true: Enable image cache reuse.

- false: Disable image cache reuse.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: EipInstanceId
parameters.description: The Elastic IP Address (EIP). If you need to pull images from the Internet, make sure that the ECI instance can access the Internet. You can configure an EIP or a NAT gateway to enable public network access.

parameters.name: EliminationStrategy
parameters.description:
The elimination strategy of the image cache. The default value is empty, which indicates that the image cache is always retained.

You can set this parameter to LRU, which indicates that the image cache can be automatically deleted. When the number of image caches reaches the quota limit, the system automatically deletes the least recently used image caches whose EliminationStrategy is set to LRU.

parameters.name: Flash
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the instant image cache feature, which accelerates image cache creation. Valid values:

- true: Enable the instant image cache feature.

- false: Disable the instant image cache feature.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: FlashCopyCount
parameters.description:
The number of local snapshot copies. By default, one image cache corresponds to one snapshot. If the image cache will be used to create multiple ECI instances in batches, configure this parameter to enable the multi-copy snapshot feature. We recommend that you add one snapshot copy for every 1,000 ECI instances.

> When the instant image cache feature is enabled (Flash is set to true), local snapshots are created first during image cache creation. After the local snapshots are created, regular snapshots start to be created. After the regular snapshots are created, the local snapshots are automatically deleted.

parameters.name: Image
parameters.description: The container images used to create the image cache.

parameters.name: ImageCacheName
parameters.description: The name of the image cache.

parameters.name: ImageCacheSize
parameters.description: The size of the image cache. Default value: 20 GiB.

parameters.name: ImageRegistryCredential
parameters.description: The image repository information.

sub_parameters.name: Password
sub_parameters.description: The password of the image repository.

sub_parameters.name: Server
sub_parameters.description: The address of the image repository, without the `http://` or `https://` prefix.

sub_parameters.name: UserName
sub_parameters.description: The username of the image repository.

parameters.name: InsecureRegistry
parameters.description:
The address of the self-managed image repository.

When you create an image cache by using images from a self-managed image repository that uses a self-signed certificate, configure this parameter to skip certificate authentication, preventing image pull failures caused by certificate authentication failure.

parameters.name: OsType
parameters.description:
The operating system of the container images. Valid values:

- Linux (default)
- Windows

> Windows is in invitational preview. To use it, submit a ticket.

parameters.name: PlainHttpRegistry
parameters.description: The address of the self-pull image repository. When you create an image cache by using images from a self-pull image repository that uses the HTTP protocol, configure this parameter so that ECI pulls images over HTTP, preventing image pull failures caused by protocol mismatch.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID.

parameters.name: RetentionDays
parameters.description:
The retention period of the image cache. The image cache is deleted after it expires. By default, the image cache never expires.

> Image caches that fail to be created are retained for only one day.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The security group ID.

parameters.name: StandardCopyCount
parameters.description:
The number of regular snapshot copies. By default, one image cache corresponds to one snapshot. If the image cache will be used to create multiple ECI instances in batches, configure this parameter to enable the multi-copy snapshot feature. We recommend that you add one snapshot copy for every 1,000 ECI instances.

> When the instant image cache feature is disabled (Flash is set to false), only regular snapshots are generated during image cache creation.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag information of the image cache. You can specify up to 20 tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the image cache.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the image cache.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID. You can specify multiple vSwitch IDs (up to 10 at a time), separated by commas (,). Example: `vsw-***,vsw-***`.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone.
